name: chhath-management-portal-svelte
description: Chhath Puja Management Portal — SvelteKit + TypeScript migration of the React SPA. SAME design/layout (reuses styles.css). Consumes the UNCHANGED management API. Work-in-progress, phase-by-phase.

scripts.comment:check: audit PR-40 / carry-over C7. This app carried 160 svelte-check warnings, 142 of them 'a form label must be associated with a control'. They are all fixed, so the gate is now closed: --fail-on-warnings means the next one fails CI instead of joining a pile nobody reads. Public/frontend-v6 has had this flag from the start.

comment:overrides: SECURITY (audit S3): docxtemplater-image-module-free pulls in deprecated xmldom (0.1.x, CRITICAL advisories). Redirect to @xmldom/xmldom via override, same as the React app.
